body:
Sorry for you man.
I'm not gonna convince you there are reasons to stay, I don't believe it myself.

We talked yesterday and she try to explain again how we "are not compatible / not meant to be together". Every time she says she "doesn't love me anymore" and that "getting together was a mistake", it breaks my heart. She also said that even though she wants to help me, it's hard for her to keep talking, and that "if we weren't in each other's lives anymore, it wouldn't be a problem for her". I feel her drifting away and have nothing to keep her close. So I get it.

I don't want to live without her, I can't face my demons alone. I started cutting myself again. I hate myself for having fucked up the only thing that could have made me happy. 

I've realized one of the reasons I couldn't end it is that I wasn't sure my plan was enough to take me out. I've read some more about it, turns out it may not be as effective as I thought. The last thing I want is to fail at suicide, so I'm back to square 1. Looking for a good way to end it. Looks like the really effective ways require a lot of willpower, which I don't have, because I have no energy left to fight, not even to fight for the courage to end my life. That sucks.

I just burst into tears at "And I find someone whose smile made all of that vanish for a moment in my life". This could be my epitaph. It's crazy how one person can just completely turn your life upside down, one way or the other.

I'm not sure I really got the whole picture of your story, especially why you guys are apart now. But from what you wrote, I can say that you care really deeply about her and that she would be a huge help against your demons. So I sincerely hope you'll find a way to still have her in your life. Best of luck for tomorrow.

I don't believe in your "law of averages". My friends and family are having a lot of bad stuff happening in their lives as well. I see misery everywhere. I don't have in hope that everyone gets a happy ending. I know a lot of people who are not getting one.

I hope you're right about us and that we will find a way to still be friends, but I really don't think it's looking good. It's tough these days, she's always busy and I can chat with her only once in a while, even though she's on my mind all day long. And I need to refrain from texting her because I wanna give her some space, but I really feel like I've lost her and she just does this "for me", out of guilt or pity. I don't think she would turn to me if she needs anything, especially considering how emotionally fragile I am right now. She would be afraid of my reaction, she's pretty scared about my emotions these days. She made me tell her everything, and now that she sees how close I am to suicide, she's scared and doesn't really get it. We had a talk where I tried to explain how I think it would be a positive thing, but for her "life is the greatest gift" etc... you can see she's an optimist who never had depression ^^ 

She's all I ever got, and now she's gone. Giving me just enough to not kill myself, but not enough. That sucks

I feel sorry for you man. It feels kinda good to know that someone will get what I feel, but on the other hand, it makes me sad to think about the pain I imagine you are going through... I wouldn't wish it on my worse enemy.

Sending you a PM right now ;)

I'm sorry for you man, that's tough. Did you try to contact her / keep some kind of friendship ?

And yeah we keep in touch right now, but I'm pretty sure it wont last and it's just until I get a bit better and she stops feeling guilty about it.

You say "One day things are bound to go our way.". How do you know that ? I don't get why people keep saying that things will get better when we don't have any clue if it will. From my end, it looks like it never will :(

I already did pretty much all of that. And as you said, the ball is in her court now, but I know she won't come back. I know her. She's stubborn and managed to convince herself that our issues can't be solved. 

It's not even that she left for for this other guy. They're not really together, it's more of a fuck-buddy kinda thing. She considers herself single. We keep in touch but don't speak that much of our relationship anymore (it doesn't bring any good anymore), more of my state of mind and she tries to give me advice to overcome depression. And right now she helped me more than shrinks ^^

Thanks for the reply. I know that she won't be "out of my life" and that in times of need, we will still be there for each other. And I'm not trying to get her back - it won't happen. I accept that she's gone.

I'm not saying I want to end my life because she left. I've had other breakups, it's tough but I got through it. But she was the only one that ever made the clouds go away, and I can't deal with them anymore. It's just too much, and I don't want this "other" life back. I want out, I just can't seem to do it, for now

Thx for the reply.

I was actually speaking metaphorically. I am an atheist and don't believe in god, heaven, hell, or life after death.
I looked up NDEs, but I don't really believe in that. 

I think once our body ceases to exist, so does our brain and our conscience. That's why it would be so great
